title: Australia Real Weddings From Coast to Country
audience: 30s, couples who are interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, 150k+ AUD budget
notes: Facet page of our own published real weddings held in Australia, grouped by setting; built like content/posts/garden-wedding/. Title 45 chars, meta title the same. Carried over from the garden facet: couples named exactly as their published story names them and linked to it; venues, vendors and labels never named (describe the setting); details only as each story states, in our own words; cards text-only until the register shows licence and couple consent; skip stories tagged as paid client features or held outside Australia. Planning lessons as venue questions. Legal line links the NOIM and who-can-perform pages (reuse facts only). No prices, venue or vendor names, best, rankings, statistics, research talk, free (use 'a route without steps'), last dance, em dashes. Never AI images for real weddings or venues. Never link /destinations/africa or /destinations/latin-america-caribbean.
